name: finanzas-usa
description: In Spanish: two advisor agents for personal finance in the United States. Indexandro builds a written investment policy (IPS), a boring indexed core and a monthly review from your Interactive Brokers CSV statements, with banded rebalancing, a capped learning sleeve and an HTML dashboard; it never places orders. Tributina organizes personal and small-business taxes (LLC, S-corp, C-corp), finds legal savings with IRS sources and prepares the work for your CPA; it never files. No credentials, no server.
